title.narrative: Towards malaria elimination in Haiti - Haiti (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Haiti, Malaria, United Nations Development Programme (UNDP Haiti)This program has the following goals: contribuer à l’amélioration de la santé des populations d’Haïti par l’interruption de la transmission autochtone de la malaria. / To contribute to the improvement of the health of Haiti's populations by interrupting the indigenous transmission of malaria.. The objectives of this program are: 100% des cas suspects dans la population ont accès à un diagnostic précoce soutenu par un programme d’assurance qualité et ont accès à un traitement efficace sans délai. / 100% of suspected cases in the population have access to early diagnosis supported by a quality assurance program and have immediate access to effective treatment.. La gestion de la chaine d’approvisionnement assurera la disponibilité d’intrants, de médicaments et autres consommables médicaux à tout moment au niveau institutionnel et communautaire / Supply chain management will ensure the availability of devices, medicines, and other medical consumables at all times at the institutional and community levels.. Renforcer la surveillance de la malaria, le suivi et l’évaluation du programme à tous les niveaux, y compris au niveau institutionnel et au niveau communautaire / Enhance malaria surveillance, program monitoring, and evaluation at all levels, including at the institutional and community levels.. Renforcer la surveillance entomologique de la malaria à tous les niveaux et s’assurer que 100% des foyers ont accès aux mesures efficaces de protection contre la malaria /Enhance entomological surveillance of malaria at all levels and ensure that 100% of households have access to effective malaria protection measures.. La Gestion du programme est renforcée au niveau national, dans les 10 départements et dans les 146 communes / Program management is strengthened at the national level, in all 10 departments, and in the 146 municipalities.. Contribuer par des interventions de communication efficaces à l’élimination de la transmission locale de la malaria en Haïti d’ici décembre 2025 / Contribute through effective communication interventions to the elimination of local malaria transmission in Haiti by December 2025.
